stage.name: Operation Pharos-2
stage.description: The maelstrom of shadows roils relentlessly, drawing in hatred.

soul_maelstrom.name: Soul Maelstrom
soul_maelstrom.flavourText: Soul fragments born of a revenant's will. Innumerable emotions intertwine within—millennia of confused memories converging into a tangible maelstrom.

prism_soul_remnant.name: Prism Soul Remnant
prism_soul_remnant.flavourText: Powerful soul remnant born of a revenant's will. As it absorbs roving maelstroms, it releases violent witchcraft and emotions that impale enemies both in front and behind.
abilities: Attacks deal Arts damage. Can pick up and retain up to 3 Soul Maelstroms.
When carrying a Soul Maelstrom, expends all Soul Maelstroms to deal continuous Arts damage to the target and all your units in a line.

penumbral_soul_husk.name: Penumbral Soul Husk
penumbral_soul_husk.flavourText: Powerful soul husk born of a revenant's will, imbued with the techniques of countless heroes in its memories. The heroes have all but fallen, but their silhouettes grow clearly through repeated remembrance.
abilities: Can pick up and retain up to 3 Soul Maelstroms.
When carrying a Soul Maelstrom, expends Soul Maelstrom to summon an orbiting soul orb that deals heavy Arts damage to your units that collide into it.

chalice_of_mortality.name: Chalice of Mortality
chalice_of_mortality.flavourText: Greater soul chalice born of a revenant's will, brimming with conviction immeasurable. The future, unforeseen but destined, is the ultimate verdict.
abilities: Shares a fraction of the damage taken by non-aerial enemies around itself.
